''See also: [[Capital (The Elder Empire: Shadow) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Capital is the largest city in the world and serves as the seat of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. It is characterized by constant noise, with streets that are never silent even in the early morning hours. A massive portion of the city's legendary size is occupied by the [[Imperial]] Palace, a structure so vast it is often considered its own city. The population of the palace staff is distinct from the general citizens, as the two groups rarely interact. The city serves as a central hub for imperial stability and civilization, housing the Emperor and his throne. Within the palace, the Emperor utilizes a specialized throne known as the [[Optasia]] to monitor [[Great Elders]] across the globe through a network of receptors. While the Capital is currently a target for [[Elderspawn]] and potential [[Great Elders]], it is defended by forces such as the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Luminian|Luminians]]. However, following the death of the Emperor, the city has faced significant instability.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|As the greatest city in the world, the Capital is located within the [[Aurelian Empire]]. This location, which carries the scent of pine, serves as a hub where citizens and magicians alike can find work performing services for hire. It is home to a [[Kanatalia]] chapter house and is a place where even the Emperor would appear at home. Having lived her entire life within its bounds, [[Shera]] eventually prepares to return to a desk job there, while the Captain also identifies the city as an intended destination.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As the largest city in the world, the Capital is a mundane location situated near [[Rainworth]] characterized by its busy streets and traffic. While the [[Independents]] have fortified a hotel on the outskirts, many companies within the city hold contracts from the [[Imperialist Guilds]] or the throne. During a period of retreat and evacuation, wagons prepared to leave as [[Shera]] and [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] held discussions within the city. The situation turned dire when the sun darkened at midday, resulting in an entire section of the Capital being destroyed. Despite this devastation, [[Loreli]] remains desperate to reach the city.}}
